signedIn: Signed in to your customer account for this agency.
claimHelp: Sign in as a verified customer, then request fresh proof for one prior request. Matching email alone never links requests.
verificationSent: If eligible, a verification email will arrive. No request or patient access has been granted.
verified: Email verified. You can now sign in.
claimed: Request claimed. Patient access still requires a separate agency grant.
empty: No records available in your current access scope.
name: Display name
duplicateHelp: Suggestions are advisory. Review each candidate; matching details do not establish identity. Patients are never merged automatically.
ignoreReason: Reason this candidate is a distinct person
duplicateNone: No probable duplicates found. Rechecked when saving.
approvedRequest: Create or link from approved request
linkPatient: Link this patient to the approved request
grantHelp: Issue only after the agency independently verifies authority for this patient. Account verification, email and family relationship are not patient authority.
inviteHelp: Create and invite caregiver accounts through Team invitations. An operational profile alone cannot receive assignments.
availabilityHelp: Times are in the agency timezone. This editor uses one interval per weekday. Existing multiple intervals are displayed and preserved until explicitly edited through a compatible editor.
multipleIntervals: This profile has multiple/effective-dated intervals. The simplified editor is read-only to preserve them.
eligibilityHelp: Qualification and hours checks do not check visit conflicts or travel buffers, confirm booking availability, or create an appointment.
eligible: Foundation checks passed; booking availability not checked.
ineligible: Foundation checks not met. Review account, service authorization, qualifications, areas and hours.
file: PDF, JPEG or PNG; maximum 5 MiB
fileHelp: Files remain unavailable until a real malware scan succeeds. Downloads recheck your current authorization; no public storage URL is exposed.
error: This action could not be completed. Your changes have not been confirmed.
unavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Private storage or scanning may need configuration.
denied: You do not have access to this resource. Sign in to the correct agency and account.
stale: This record changed. Refresh before submitting again.
validation: Check required fields, dates, intervals and duplicate reviews.
expired: This verification link expired. Request a new verification email.
used: This verification link was already used.
